title: DoP open Standard: Method for transferring DSD Audio over PCM Frames, Version 1.1 (2012-03-30)
note: The DoP standard itself (open, freely published). Primary source for every DoP requirement.

title: IEC 61937-1:2021 ed. 3.0, General — publisher's free preview (front matter only)
note: Only the table of contents, foreword, scope, normative references and terms are public. The clause text that defines the burst-preamble, burst-payload and stuffing is NOT in this file (paid standard, not bought). Usable for terms/definitions and clause titles only.

title: IEC 61937-2:2021 ed. 3.0, Burst-info — publisher's free preview (front matter only)
note: Front matter only. The data-type code table itself is NOT in this file.

title: IEC 61937-3:2017 ed. 3.0, AC-3 and enhanced AC-3 — publisher's free preview (front matter only)
note: Front matter only (contents, foreword, scope, terms). Clause 4-5 text is NOT in this file.

title: IEC 61937-5:2006 ed. 2.0, DTS — publisher's free preview (front matter only)
note: Front matter only. Clause text is NOT in this file.

title: SMPTE ST 337:2015, Format for Non-PCM Audio and Data in an AES3 Serial Digital Audio Interface
note: Free from SMPTE. The PROFESSIONAL (AES3) counterpart of IEC 61937, not IEC 61937 itself. Same burst structure (Pa/Pb/Pc/Pd); differences from the consumer standard are possible and must not be assumed away.

title: SMPTE ST 338:2016, Format for Non-PCM Audio and Data in AES3 — Data Types
note: Free from SMPTE. Data-type codes for ST 337 (professional). These numbers are NOT guaranteed to equal IEC 61937-2 data-type codes.

title: SMPTE ST 340:2015, Format for Non-PCM Audio and Data in AES3 — ATSC A/52 (AC-3) Data Type
note: Free from SMPTE. AC-3 (and possibly E-AC-3) carriage in ST 337 (professional).

title: ATSC A/52:2018, Digital Audio Compression (AC-3, E-AC-3) Standard
note: AC-3 / E-AC-3 frame syntax (syncword, bsmod, frmsizecod, frame sizes, E-AC-3 Annex E). Has no IEC 61937 annex in this edition.

title: ETSI TS 102 366 V1.4.1, Digital Audio Compression (AC-3, Enhanced AC-3) Standard
note: European edition of the AC-3/E-AC-3 syntax (cross-check of A/52). No IEC 61937 annex.

title: ETSI TS 102 114 V1.6.1, DTS Coherent Acoustics; Core and Extensions with Additional Profiles
note: DTS core frame header syntax (SYNC, NBLKS, FSIZE). Not an IEC 61937 document.

title: FFmpeg n7.1 libavformat S/PDIF (IEC 61937) muxer source
note: SECONDARY REFERENCE, NOT A SPECIFICATION. An independent open-source implementation of IEC 61937 framing. Any requirement resting only on this file is labelled tier=secondary and is evidence of agreement with FFmpeg, not of conformance to IEC 61937.
